definitions.explanation: Describes something that shines brightly or gleams, often with reflected light. Used for polished surfaces, stars, or clean objects.

examples.japanese: ⟦{靴|くつ}→靴：00725_kutsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ぴかぴか⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{磨|みが}いた→磨く：02427_migaku⟧。
examples.english: I polished my shoes until they were shiny.

examples.japanese: ⟦{星|ほし}→星：01510_hoshi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ぴかぴか⟦{光|ひか}っている→光る：01163_hikaru⟧。
ぴかぴか⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{新車|しんしゃ}→新車：11334_shinsha⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: I bought a brand-new shiny car.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子|こ}ども→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦たち→達：01551_tachi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{窓|まど}→窓：02254_mado⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ぴかぴか⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{磨|みが}いて→磨く：02427_migaku⟧⟦くれた→くれる：00724_kureru⟧。
examples.english: The children polished the windows until they were sparkling.

examples.japanese: ⟦{入学式|にゅうがくしき}→入学式：05495_nyuugakushiki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧、ぴかぴか⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ランドセル→ランドセル：11191_randoseru⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{背負|せお}った→背負う：16159_seou⟧⟦{一年生|いちねんせい}→一年生：27559_ichinensei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{校門|こうもん}→校門：13116_koumon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{並|なら}んでいた→並ぶ：00605_narabu⟧。
examples.english: On the day of the entrance ceremony, first-graders carrying brand-new shiny school backpacks were lined up in front of the school gate.

notes:
ぴかぴか is an onomatopoeic word (⟦{擬態語|ぎたいご}→擬態語：22468_gitaigo⟧) that mimics the visual impression of sparkling or gleaming.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ぴかぴか⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{磨|みが}く→磨く：02427_migaku⟧: to polish until shiny
- ぴかぴか⟦{光|ひか}る→光る：01163_hikaru⟧: to sparkle, shine brightly
- ぴかぴか⟦の→の：09472_no⟧〜: brand-new, sparkling clean (noun modifier)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦きらきら→きらきら：05159_kirakira⟧: twinkling, sparkling (often for smaller, softer lights like stars)
- ⟦ぎらぎら→ぎらぎら：05359_giragira⟧: glaring, dazzling (harsh, intense light)
